name: CDR132L
sort_evidence: CDR132L is the miR-132 antisense oligonucleotide Novo acquired with Cardior; after the HF-REVERT miss (https://pharmaphorum.com/news/novo-nordisk-microrna-drug-fluffs-its-lines-heart-failure) its two chronic heart failure Phase 2 trials NCT06979362 and NCT06979375 are recruiting, and no discontinuation was found.
